# Prepare and flatten Crew Change Plan data
# for the downstream risk assessment workflow

items = _items

prepared_cases = []

for item in items:
    data = item["json"]
    fields = data.get("fields", {})

    prepared_case = {
        # Keep Airtable Record ID for future updates
        "airtable_record_id": data.get("id"),

        # Core identification
        "crew_change_id": fields.get("crew_change_id"),
        "vessel_code": fields.get("vessel_code"),
        "seafarer_id": fields.get("seafarer_id"),
        "rank": fields.get("rank"),
        "movement_type": fields.get("movement_type"),

        # Linked Airtable records
        "origin_airport_id": (
            fields.get("origin_airport", [None])[0]
        ),
        "connection_airport_id": (
            fields.get("connection_airport", [None])[0]
        ),
        "destination_airport_id": (
            fields.get("destination_airport", [None])[0]
        ),
        "joining_port_id": (
            fields.get("joining_port", [None])[0]
        ),

        # Travel planning
        "number_of_connections": fields.get(
            "number_of_connections"
        ),
        "shortest_connection_minutes": fields.get(
            "shortest_connection_minutes"
        ),
        "scheduled_departure": fields.get(
            "scheduled_departure"
        ),
        "scheduled_arrival": fields.get(
            "scheduled_arrival"
        ),
        "reporting_deadline": fields.get(
            "reporting_deadline"
        ),
        "vessel_eta": fields.get(
            "vessel_eta"
        ),
        "port_transfer_minutes": fields.get(
            "port_transfer_minutes"
        ),

        # Operational confirmations
        "port_agent_confirmed": fields.get(
            "port_agent_confirmed"
        ),
        "vessel_eta_confidence": fields.get(
            "vessel_eta_confidence"
        ),

        # Documentation
        "visa_status": fields.get("visa_status"),
        "ticket_status": fields.get("ticket_status"),
        "documents_verified": fields.get(
            "documents_verified"
        ),
        "passport_valid": fields.get(
            "passport_valid"
        ),
        "medical_valid": fields.get(
            "medical_valid"
        ),

        # Financial
        "estimated_travel_cost_eur": fields.get(
            "estimated_travel_cost_eur"
        ),

        # Existing public operational context
        "destination_delay_risk_public": (
            fields.get(
                "destination_delay_risk_public",
                [None]
            )[0]
            if fields.get("destination_delay_risk_public")
            else None
        ),
        "destination_delay_minutes_public": (
            fields.get(
                "destination_delay_minutes_public",
                [None]
            )[0]
            if fields.get("destination_delay_minutes_public")
            else None
        ),

        # Workflow status
        "processing_status": fields.get(
            "processing_status"
        )
    }

    prepared_cases.append({
        "json": prepared_case
    })


return prepared_cases

# Create a list for cleaned airport records
output = []

# Loop through incoming items
for incoming_item in _items:

    # Get the Airtable fields
    fields = incoming_item["json"].get("fields", {})

    # Keep only operationally useful airport information
    clean_airport = {
        "iata_code": fields.get("iata_code"),
        "icao_code": fields.get("icao_code"),
        "airport_name": fields.get("airport_name"),
        "municipality": fields.get("municipality"),
        "country_code": fields.get("country_code"),
        "latitude": fields.get("latitude"),
        "longitude": fields.get("longitude")
    }

    # Add the cleaned origin airport
    output.append({
        "json": {
            "origin_airport": clean_airport
        }
    })

# Return cleaned records
return output

import re

output_items = []

for item in _items:
    data = item["json"]["output"]

    match = re.search(r"CC-\d+", data["executive_assessment"])
    crew_change_id = match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

    report = ""

    report += f"Crew Change Risk Briefing - {crew_change_id}\n\n"
    report += "AI Operational Risk Assessment\n\n"

    report += "Executive Assessment\n"
    report += f"{data['executive_assessment']}\n\n"

    report += "Key Risk Drivers\n"
    for driver in data["key_risk_drivers"]:
        report += f"• {driver}\n"

    report += "\nRecommended Actions\n"
    for index, action in enumerate(data["recommended_actions"], start=1):
        report += f"{index}. {action}\n"

    report += "\nAI Recommendation\n"
    report += f"{data['ai_recommendation']}\n\n"

    report += "Rationale\n"
    report += f"{data['recommendation_rationale']}\n\n"

    report += "Assessment Limitation\n"
    report += f"{data['assessment_limitation']}"

    output_items.append({
        "json": {
            "crew_change_id": crew_change_id,
            "report": report
        }
    })

return output_items
